problem: We want to reduce B2B SaaS subscription churn before annual renewal, but we do not have a clean dataset yet. We have 5,000 enterprise accounts, an 8% annual churn rate, a $50 CSM intervention cost, and $2,500 saved per retained account.

Our fintech app needs to block fraudulent card transactions at checkout across 50,000 monthly transactions without uploading confidential customer data. Fraud rate is 1.5%, manual review costs $4, and each caught fraud saves $180.

Our hospital wants to predict at the moment of patient discharge whether a patient will be readmitted within 30 days. Because of HIPAA privacy rules we cannot upload patient records. We discharge 3,000 patients a month with a 12% readmission rate; a follow-up nurse visit costs $80 and avoids a $1,600 penalty.

We want to predict industrial compressor failure 7 days before breakdown across 1,200 factory machines, but we have not started logging sensor tables yet. A preventive inspection costs $120 and avoids $3,000 in unplanned downtime.
We need to estimate the spot freight price per shipment at booking time before we have historical lane data.
We want to segment our e-commerce buyers into behavioral cohorts for tailored lifecycle marketing, but we don't have data ready to upload yet.

We have no CRM export yet. We want to rank 10,000 monthly inbound leads by likelihood of converting to a paid contract within 30 days so sales reps call the best leads first. Calling a lead costs $15 and a closed deal is worth $900, with a 5% baseline conversion rate.
